items.stem: State any three features of business environment.

items.answer: (i) Identifying opportunities and first mover advantage; identifying threats and early warning signals. (ii) Dynamic nature; uncertainty (also inter-relatedness).

The transfer of public sector enterprises to the private sector by selling part or all of the government's shares.

items.stem:
Aisha runs a electronic goods shop in Bhopal that used to accept only cash. After November 2016 her sales fell for a few weeks; she then started accepting UPI and card payments and sales recovered.
(i) Identify two impacts of demonetisation in the case. (ii) State two features of demonetisation.
items.answer: (i) Short-term fall in demand for cash-based sales; increase in digital transactions. (ii) Measure to curb black money and corruption; move towards a less-cash economy; tax administration measure (any two).
items.markingKey: 4 marks: (i) Short-term fall in demand for cash-based sales; increase in digital transactions. (ii) Measure to curb black money and corruption; move towards a less-cash economy; tax administration measure (any two).

items.stem: Explain the following dimensions of business environment: (i) Legal environment (ii) Technological environment.
items.answer: (i) Legal environment: Laws, orders, court judgements and decisions of commissions. (ii) Technological environment: Scientific improvements and innovations.
items.markingKey: 2 marks each: (i) Laws, orders, court judgements and decisions of commissions. (ii) Scientific improvements and innovations.

items.stem: The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate, so loans for Bansal Stores became costlier. Which dimension of business environment is highlighted?
items.answer: Economic environment
items.markingKey: (a) Economic environment. Interest rates are part of the economic environment.

items.stem: Which of the following statements about the economic reforms of 1991 is NOT correct?
items.answer: Privatisation means a larger role for the public sector.
items.markingKey: (c) Incorrect statement: Privatisation means a larger role for the public sector.
options: The New Industrial Policy was announced in 1991.
Privatisation means a larger role for the public sector.
Disinvestment is a part of privatisation.
